english.title: Enter / remain on tramstop on the Croydon Tramlink system in order to skateboard / roller-skate / ride a cycle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the permission of an authorised person

(A)_[entered]_
(B)_[remained]_

on a tramstop, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAMSTOP..), on the Croydon Tramlink system for the purposes of

(C)_[skateboarding]_
(D)_[roller-skating]_
(E)_[bicycle riding]_

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 14(3) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
